model_annotation: The line plot in Figure 3(a) illustrates the relationship between batch size and inference time in seconds for three models. The x-axis represents batch size on a logarithmic scale, ranging from 1 to 300, with tick labels at 1, 16, 32, 64, 128, 256, and 300. The y-axis represents inference time in seconds on a linear scale, ranging from 0 to 10, with tick labels at intervals of 2. The plot displays three lines: a blue line representing Llama-1B, an orange line representing LlamaInLlama-1B, and a red line representing MambaInLlama-1B. The blue line starts at approximately 2 seconds and increases to around 8 seconds as batch size increases from 1 to 300. The orange line starts at around 3 seconds and rises to approximately 6 seconds over the same range. The red line begins at about 2.8 seconds and climbs to roughly 4.7 seconds across the batch size range.
